text:
emily: Quick reminder — we need to create an annotated tag and publish a draft GH release for v1.12.0 before today's cutoff. Cutoff = 17:00 PT. Can folks confirm artifacts and changelog are ready? I'll handle the release notes but need the annotated tag pushed and the build artifact URL.

aj: I can do the tag once artifacts are available. Are we doing a signed annotated tag or the usual `git tag -a v1.12.0 -m \"Release v1.12.0\"` then `git push origin v1.12.0`?

mike: Pipeline will upload artifacts in ~20m. I'll post the artifact URL when done. Currently running the final smoke tests.

sophia: Changelog PR has been merged into main earlier today (PR #789). I left a migration note about the KV cache behavior; we should include that in the release body.

release-bot: CI summary — main build: passing ✅, artifact upload: pending, security scan: queued.

aj: OK. Once Mike confirms artifact URL I'll create the annotated tag and the draft via GH CLI. Command I'll use:```\n# create annotated tag\ngit tag -a v1.12.0 -m \"Release v1.12.0\"\ngit push origin v1.12.0\n# create draft release\ngh release create v1.12.0 ./artifact.tar.gz --title \"v1.12.0\" --notes-file RELEASE_NOTES.md --draft\n```\n\nemily: GH CLI is fine. Please ensure the release points to target `main`, include the migration note under a \"Migration\" header, and do NOT mark as prerelease. Also add the artifact link into the release body.

mike: Artifact uploaded: https://ci.internal.example/builds/12345/artifact.tar.gz ✅ All smoke tests green.

aj: Tag created and pushed: `git tag -a v1.12.0 -m \\"Release v1.12.0\\"` then `git push origin v1.12.0`. Created draft release with GH CLI and attached artifact. Draft URL (placeholder): https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/releases/tag/v1.12.0-draft :thumbsup:

sophia: Small ask — can we add an explicit cache-invalidation step in the migration notes? I'll append a short paragraph to RELEASE_NOTES.md now.

emily: Thanks. One more: we need the regression fix backported to release-1.x before we publish the public release. @aj can you open a backport PR and link it in the draft?

aj: On it. I'll open a one-line backport PR and link from the release body. ETA 30m.

ci-bot: Backport PR #792 opened by @aj -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/792. CI: running tests.

mike: Backport tests passed. Ready to merge.

sophia: Approved and merged the backport. I also updated the RELEASE_NOTES.md to include the cache invalidation steps and a short code snippet.

emily: Great. We'll hold final publish until 18:00 PT so SOC and support can review. If no flags by then I'll hit Publish. :rocket: 

aj: Sounds good. I'll add the backport PR link to the draft release body and set a reminder to publish at 18:00 PT.

release-bot: Reminder scheduled — publish-check at 2024-04-15T18:00:00-07:00.

emily: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround. If anything unexpected comes up ping this thread or DM.

mike: Thanks — will monitor. :eyes:

sophia: LGTM.

aj: Done, linking everything now.

(End of thread)
